semanticQuota.title: Semantic indexing quotas
semanticQuota.scope: These counters cover boundary and final-document embeddings for semantic indexing only. Other strategies and calls before tracking began are excluded. This is technical work accounting, not money, credits or a provider invoice.
semanticQuota.notTracked: No semantic work has been tracked yet. Historical provider calls are not included.
semanticQuota.unknownProviderTokenBatches: Batches with unknown native token usage
semanticQuota.unknownBilledTokenBatches: Batches with unknown billed token usage
semanticQuota.usageHint: Dispatches record intent and can include uncertain work. One logical batch may have up to three internal transport attempts; wire requests and charges are not counted exactly. Known token subtotals are incomplete when unknown batches remain. Missing usage never means zero.
semanticQuota.embeddingBatchesPerCandidate: Lifetime logical batch allowance per candidate
semanticQuota.limitsHint: 1 MiB = 1,048,576 bytes. Organization planning capacity must cover one document allowance; both outstanding work caps must admit a complete candidate allowance. A candidate shares its lifetime allowance across boundary planning, final embeddings and retries. Reducing limits does not remove stored data. Only a platform administrator can change limits.
semanticQuota.defaults: Platform defaults. Saving creates an organization override.
semanticQuota.loadFailed: Semantic limits and usage could not be loaded. Check your platform access and retry.
semanticQuota.saveFailed: Semantic quotas could not be saved. Check your values and platform access, then retry.
semanticQuota.invalid: Enter safe whole numbers within the displayed limits. Organization planning capacity must cover one document allowance, and each outstanding work cap must cover a complete candidate allowance.
